results.title: NEET PG Exam Duty Won’t Shut CGHS Wellness Centres; Ministry Declares Viral August 27–31 Closure Notice Fake
results.description: CGHS has declared a viral notice claiming Wellness Centres will remain closed from August 27 to 31 for NEET PG duty as fake. All centres will function as usual, and beneficiaries should rely only on official CGHS updates.
